ai.title: Add bounded user-agent normalizer for analytics
ai.summary: A new module in `common/src/util/client-user-agent.ts` exports `normalizeClientUserAgent` and `clientUserAgentFields`, which reduce an HTTP `User-Agent` to a single lowercased RFC 7231 product token plus an optional version. The product is stripped to `[a-z0-9._-]` and collapsed to unrecognized when empty or over 32 chars, while versions failing `VERSION_RE` or longer than 16 chars are omitted, never truncated. This gives analytics a second client-identity signal after the 2026-08-03 false-positive ban that came from treating `session.fingerprint_id` as client identity.
ai.evidence: New file `common/src/util/client-user-agent.ts` defines `MAX_PRODUCT_LEN = 32`, `MAX_VERSION_LEN = 16`, `VERSION_RE = /^\d[0-9A-Za-z.+-]*$/`, exports `UNRECOGNIZED_CLIENT`, `NormalizedClientUserAgent`, `normalizeClientUserAgent`, and `clientUserAgentFields`, with tests asserting behaviors like collapsing over-long products to unrecognized and dropping implausible version tokens.
ai.unknowns: No call site for `clientUserAgentFields` is shown in the diff, so it is in place but not yet wired into an event payload.
